summary: The bad() method reads a line from an external URL and passes it directly to dbConnection.setCatalog(data), letting an attacker-controlled value set a system/configuration setting (CWE-15). I added input validation so the catalog is only set when the externally sourced value is non-null and matches a safe database-identifier pattern (letters, digits, underscores). This preserves the feature for legitimate catalog names while rejecting arbitrary/unexpected external input.
